# Tools

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

92 tools. Every one runs in the browser; each has "Try" examples on its page.

## Encoding

| Tool                                                   | What it does                                                                                                                                                | Also known as                                                                                      |

## Crypto

| Tool                                                 | What it does                                                                                                                                                                            | Also known as                                                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **ADFGX / ADFGVX** (`adfgvx`)                        | German WWI field ciphers: a keyed Polybius square turns each letter into two coordinate letters, then a columnar transposition mixes them. Encrypt or decrypt with your square and key. | adfgx, adfgvx, fractionated, fractionation, polybius, columnar                                |
| **Affine cipher** (`affine`)                         | Affine cipher E(x) = a·x + b mod 26. Brute-force mode ranks all 312 keys.                                                                                                               | affine, a*x+b, monoalphabetic, linear cipher, decimation                                      |
| **Atbash** (`atbash`)                                | Mirror the alphabet (A↔Z, B↔Y…). Encrypting and decrypting are the same step.                                                                                                           | reverse alphabet, mirror alphabet, hebrew, substitution, monoalphabetic                       |
| **Bacon cipher** (`bacon`)                           | Decode or encode Bacon’s two-symbol cipher (A/B, 0/1, or upper/lower case hidden in text).                                                                                              | baconian, francis bacon, aabbb, binary letters, 5-bit, steganography                          |
| **Bifid / Trifid** (`bifid`)                         | Delastelle's Bifid and Trifid ciphers with a keyed square or cube and a period: encrypt, decrypt, or find the period.                                                                   | bifid, trifid, delastelle, fractionation, fractionating, polybius                             |
| **Cipher identifier** (`cipher-identify`)            | Paste a ciphertext: index of coincidence, repeats and other statistics rank the likely ciphers and encodings, with a one-click Open in the right tool.                                  | identify cipher, which cipher, cipher detector, cipher identifier, dcode, boxentriq           |
| **Columnar transposition** (`columnar`)              | Columnar, double columnar, Myszkowski, route / spiral and scytale transpositions: encrypt, decrypt, or solve a columnar cipher without its key (English).                               | transposition, columnar, column transposition, double transposition, myszkowski, route cipher |
| **Enigma machine** (`enigma`)                        | Encrypt or decrypt with the Enigma I, M3 or M4 (rotors, rings, plugboard), follow every key press, or search a known plaintext for the rotors and start positions.                      | enigma, rotor, rotor machine, plugboard, steckerbrett, ringstellung                           |
| **Frequency analysis** (`frequency`)                 | Letter frequencies, index of coincidence and n-grams: tells you which classical cipher to try.                                                                                          | letter frequency, ioc, index of coincidence, chi squared, bigram, trigram                     |
| **Hash / checksum** (`hash`)                         | MD5, SHA-1/2/3, NTLM, RIPEMD, BLAKE, Whirlpool, CRC32 and more in one run, with HMAC and compare.                                                                                       | md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, sha3, keccak                                                       |
| **Hash identifier** (`hash-identify`)                | Tell which hash a string is (MD5, NTLM, bcrypt, sha512crypt, Kerberos...) and get the hashcat and John names.                                                                           | hashid, name-that-hash, hash-identifier, identify hash, hashcat, john                         |
| **Hill cipher** (`hill`)                             | Encrypt or decrypt with a Hill key matrix and see why a key has no inverse, recover the key from known plaintext, or crack a 2×2 Hill cipher with no key.                               | hill, hill cipher, matrix cipher, lester hill, linear algebra, key matrix                     |
| **JWT** (`jwt`)                                      | Decode, verify, forge (alg none / HS256) and crack the secret of a JSON Web Token, offline.                                                                                             | jwt.io, json web token, bearer, hs256, rs256, alg none                                        |
| **Nihilist cipher** (`nihilist`)                     | Nihilist cipher: Polybius coordinates plus a repeating numeric key, added as numbers. Encrypt, decrypt, guess the key length from the numbers, or run the Nihilist transposition.       | nihilist, nihilist cipher, polybius, numbers, checkerboard, addition                          |
| **Playfair / Two-square / Four-square** (`playfair`) | Encrypt or decrypt Playfair, two-square and four-square digraph ciphers, or find a Playfair key with no key at all.                                                                     | playfair, digraph, digram, polygraphic, two-square, double playfair                           |
| **Polybius / Tap code** (`polybius`)                 | Polybius square, tap code and ADFGX coordinates: letters to digit pairs, dots or ADFGX.                                                                                                 | polybius square, tap code, knock code, prisoner cipher, adfgx, checkerboard                   |
| **Rail fence** (`rail-fence`)                        | Zigzag transposition cipher. ## Steganography

| Tool                                                                 | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Also known as                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Barcode from modules** (`barcode-pattern`)                         | Decode a barcode written out as text: a row of 1 and 0 (or ▮ and ▯) for a 1D code, bar and space widths, or a grid of lines for a 2D code such as QR or Data Matrix.                                                                                                        | barcode, bars, modules, pattern, bit matrix, binary grid                                                      |
| **Barcode reader** (`barcode`)                                       | Read 1D and 2D barcodes in an image (Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, UPC, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, MaxiCode, QR...), several at once, tilted or inverted; shows text, raw bytes and where each one is.                                                                        | barcode, bar code, ean, upc, gtin, isbn                                                                       |
| **Bit planes / color filters** (`bit-planes`)                        | See every bit plane of every colour channel (like StegSolve), plus inverted, grayscale, random-colour and other filters that reveal hidden pictures.                                                                                                                        | stegsolve, bit plane, color filter, channel, xor, invert                                                      |
| **Channel reveal (R/G/B/C/M/Y/K)** (`channel-reveal`)                | Isolate one colour channel (R, G, B, alpha, C, M, Y, K, luma) and amplify it to reveal faint yellow dots, near-white text and other colour-channel steganography.                                                                                                           | channel, colour channel, color channel, blue channel, yellow dots, printer dots                               |
| **Combine two images** (`image-combine`)                             | XOR, subtract or diff two images pixel by pixel to reveal what differs between them.                                                                                                                                                                                        | stegsolve, image combiner, xor images, diff, compare, twin                                                    |
| **EMD steganography** (`emd`)                                        | Read or hide a message with EMD (Exploiting Modification Direction): every group of n pixels carries one digit in base 2n+1. Decodes with your settings, searches the usual ones, or hides a message and checks it by decoding it back.                                     | exploiting modification direction, emd, steganography, pixel group, base 5, modulo                            |
| **EXIF / metadata** (`metadata`)                                     | Read EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC and ICC data plus PNG text and JPEG comments from a photo, and pull out the embedded thumbnail.                                                                                                                                                   | exiftool, exif, gps, xmp, iptc, icc                                                                           |
| **Hidden bits in base64 / base32 padding** (`basen-padding`)         | Read the bits hidden in the "=" padding of base64 / base32 lines, follow several layers, or hide a message that way.                                                                                                                                                        | base-N padding, padding steganography, base64 steganography, base32 steganography, trailing bits, unused bits |
| **Hidden Unicode text (homoglyphs + invisibles)** (`unicode-hidden`) | Find lookalike letters and invisible characters in a text, name every unusual code point, decode the message they hide, or hide your own.                                                                                                                                   | homoglyph, confusables, lookalike letters, cyrillic a, mixed script, unicode names                            |
| **Image analyzer (metadata, GPS, hashes)** (`image-analyzer`)        | Drop an image, see everything: EXIF/IPTC/XMP/ICC fields, GPS on a map, MD5/SHA hashes, the EXIF thumbnail checked against the picture, appended data and strings.                                                                                                           | aperisolve, exiftool, exif, gps, location, geolocation                                                        |
| **Image structure (PNG/JPEG/GIF)** (`image-structure`)               | Walk the chunks, segments and blocks of a PNG, JPEG or GIF: bad CRCs, hidden text, appended files, and a repair for PNGs whose size was edited.                                                                                                                             | pngcheck, png, jpeg, gif, chunk, crc                                                                          |
| **LSB extract** (`lsb`)                                              | Pull hidden data out of the lowest bits of image pixels: auto-scan every common combination, or pick channels and bits yourself.                                                                                                                                            | zsteg, steganography, least significant bit, bit plane, pixel, png                                            |
| **PNG chunk surgeon (inspect, repair, reorder)** (`png-surgeon`)     | Black or broken PNG? Lists every chunk without stopping at the first error, shows the text chunks, puts shuffled IDAT chunks back in order (from a hint, by hand, or by search), repairs CRCs, signature, zlib header and IHDR size, and shows the rebuilt image. PNG only. | pngcheck, idat, idat order, shuffled chunks, reorder, chunk                                                   |
| **Printer dots — DocuColor matrix** (`docucolor`)                    | Decode or build the Xerox DocuColor yellow-dot tracking grid (15 × 8): print date, time and printer serial, with parity check.                                                                                                                                              | yellow dots, tracking dots, machine identification code, MIC, printer steganography, Xerox                    |
| **Printer tracking dots (yellow dots / MIC)** (`printer-dots`)       | Find the Xerox DocuColor yellow-dot grid in a scan, fit it (rotation, pitch, origin, orientation) and decode the print date, time and printer serial, with parity check.                                                                                                    | yellow dots, tracking dots, machine identification code, MIC, docucolor, printer steganography                |
| **QR code reader** (`qr`)                                            | Decode QR codes in an image, even inverted, tiny, noisy or missing their quiet zone; shows text and raw bytes. Other barcodes (1D, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417): Barcode reader.                                                                                             | qr, qrcode, barcode, scan, decode, jsqr                                                                       |
| **Text analyzer (full scan)** (`text-analyzer`)                      | Paste a text: every hidden-text check runs at once (acrostics, invisible characters, encodings, ciphers) and the most readable results rise to the top.                                                                                                                     | acrostic, acrostiche, hidden message, texte caché, null cipher, magic                                         |
| **Whitespace steganography** (`whitespace`)                          | Read messages hidden in trailing spaces and tabs (stegsnow and simple bit schemes), or hide your own.                                                                                                                                                                       | snow, stegsnow, trailing spaces, tabs, spaces, whitespace language                                            |
| **Zero-width / invisible text** (`zero-width`)                       | Find invisible Unicode characters in text, decode the message they hide, or hide your own.                                                                                                                                                                                  | zero width, zwsp, zwnj, invisible, unicode steganography, tag characters                                      |

## Forensics

| Tool                                                                       | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Also known as                                                     |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Archive extractor** (`archive`)                                          | Open ZIP, GZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ, zlib and raw deflate: list entries, show hidden details, extract, and decrypt ZipCrypto with a password.                                                                        | unzip, gunzip, tar, zip, gzip, extract                            |
| **Binary analyzer (.bin, disk images, unknown files)** (`binary-analyzer`) | Identify an unknown binary or disk image (a BIN without its CUE, ISO, FAT), carve the files hidden in it, list and extract the files of the disk, or read it as numbers. Big files are read in pieces.       | bin, cue, bin/cue, iso, iso9660, disk image                       |
| **Carve embedded files** (`carve`)                                         | Find files hidden inside other files by their magic bytes, work out where each ends, and extract them.                                                                                                       | binwalk, foremost, scalpel, extract, embedded, appended           |
| **Entropy** (`entropy`)                                                    | Measure how random the data is, block by block: spot encrypted or compressed parts, and plot the byte histogram.                                                                                             | shannon, randomness, encrypted, compressed, histogram, binwalk -E |
| **Executable analyzer (ELF, PE, Mach-O)** (`exe-analyzer`)                 | Inspect an ELF, Windows PE (exe, dll, sys) or Mach-O file without running it: headers, sections with entropy, symbols, imports, resources, checksec-style protections, packer hints and strings per section. | readelf, objdump, rabin2, pe-bear, pefile, checksec               |
| **File type** (`file-type`)                                                | Identify a file from its magic bytes, flag a wrong extension or a damaged header.                                                                                                                            | magic, file, signature, header, mime, libmagic                    |
| **Hexdump / xxd** (`hexdump`)                                              | Show any data as a hex dump (xxd, hexdump -C), or turn a pasted dump back into bytes.                                                                                                                        | xxd, hexdump, hex, od, dump, xxd -r                               |
| **JavaScript deobfuscator (sandbox)** (`js-deobfuscate`)                   | Peel obfuscated JavaScript layer by layer: read it (escapes, fromCharCode, atob, unescape) or run it once in a network-less sandbox that records every eval, Function, atob and unescape.                    | javascript, js, deobfuscate, deobfuscator, obfuscated, eval       |
| **PCAP analyzer** (`pcap`)                                                 | Open a .pcap or .pcapng capture: follow TCP streams, export HTTP/FTP files, find credentials, DNS and flags.                                                                                                 | wireshark, tshark, pcap, pcapng, network, capture                 |
| **PDF analyzer** (`pdf-analyzer`)                                          | Open a PDF like pdfid, pdf-parser and peepdf: every object and stream, older revisions, hidden text, JavaScript, embedded files, forms and metadata.                                                         | pdf, pdfid, pdf-parser, peepdf, qpdf, pdftotext                   |
| **SQLite database** (`sqlite`)                                             | Open a SQLite database (browser history, app data, CTF .db files): tables, BLOBs, read-only SQL, deleted rows left in the file, WAL.                                                                         | sqlite3, sqlite, db, database, sql, browser history               |
| **Strings** (`strings`)                                                    | Pull readable text out of binary data, ASCII and UTF-16, with offsets. Flag-like strings come first.                                                                                                         | strings -a, strings -el, printable, ascii, utf-16, wide           |

## Audio

| Tool                                                               | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Also known as                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Audio lab** (`audio-lab`)                                        | Reverse, speed up or slow down, stretch, pitch-shift and split channels, then listen to the result, download it as WAV and see its spectrogram.                                                                       | reverse audio, backwards, slow down, speed up, time stretch, pitch shift                   |
| **Audio steganography (LSB, tags, appended data)** (`audio-stego`) | Find data hidden in a WAV, AIFF, MP3, FLAC or Ogg file: the low bits of the samples (auto-scan), extra chunks, tags and cover pictures, data between or after the audio, and a plot of where the low bits carry data. | audio steganography, wav lsb, least significant bit, hidden data in sound, riff chunk, id3 |
| **DTMF / phone tones** (`dtmf`)                                    | Decode the keys of touch-tone dialling in a recording, and read them as phone-keypad text.                                                                                                                            | dtmf, touch tone, telephone, dial, multimon-ng, keypad                                     |
| **Morse from audio** (`morse-audio`)                               | Decode beeps (Morse code) in a recording: finds the pitch, the speed and the letters.                                                                                                                                 | morse, cw, beeps, telegraph, dit dah, dot dash                                             |
| **Spectrogram** (`spectrogram`)                                    | Draw an audio file as a spectrogram to reveal text or pictures hidden in the sound.                                                                                                                                   | sonic visualiser, audacity, fft, stft, frequency, waveform                                 |
| **SSTV (slow-scan TV)** (`sstv`)                                   | Decode a slow-scan television recording (Robot, Martin, Scottie, PD) from WAV, MP3, FLAC or Ogg into the picture it carries.                                                                                          | sstv, slow scan, slowscan, slow-scan television, qsstv, rx-sstv                            |
